artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan converting the measured, vendor-owned cross-repo injection residual into durable source-store record, a read-only falsification probe, and two verbatim owner actions.

memory_candidates.content: When authoring a plan's per-phase Tier Justification, suite_selection_select's union behavior decides the honest answer: if ANY path in a phase's Files to modify set resolves to no suite, the whole selection collapses to __FULL_SWEEP__, regardless of how many suites the other paths map to. Its resolution is basename-driven (self-identity, test-<basename> pairing, then a grep of test suites for the literal basename), so a generic basename like README.md or EXTENSION.md pulls a long incidental suite list that is noise rather than real coverage. Partitioning phases so each one's path set contains at least one genuinely unmapped source-store markdown file yields the sentinel honestly, and the covering check is then plan-format.md's sub-case (b) gate subset: verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 <repo_root>, with repo_root the directory holding .claude-extensions.json, never source_dir itself (a source-store directory has no .claude/ and gate0 exits 2 before gate selection).
